Astronomers have found a green star. That’s not supposed to be possible, because stars hot enough to be green also mix all colours together and end up looking white. In today's video I explain why stars can be green nevertheless. Let’s take a look.

Paper: https://doi.org/10.1093/rasti/rzag069
